summary: scripts/st-test appends one JSON line per run (total and per-check seconds, and linux-gate's stages when scripts/ci-local prints its stage table) to ~/.local/state/st-test/runs.jsonl, and the new read-only scripts/st-test-report reports count, p50 and p90 of full warm runs against the per-PR suite's objective: 12 minutes or less on a dev box, breached when p90 is over 12 minutes or any full warm run is over 15.

replay.detail: No record, signature, skip policy or verifier rule changes; what st-test runs and signs is unchanged.

schema.detail: No database schema change. The runs file is a new local JSON Lines file (records carry "v": 1); ST_TEST_RUNS names another path or `off`.

rules.detail: Recording is fail-soft: a file that cannot be written prints one line on stderr and never changes st-test's exit code.

compatibility.detail: st-test's summary and exit codes are unchanged. linux-gate's output now passes through st-test (copied to the terminal as it comes and kept for the stage table) instead of going straight to the terminal; its time limit is unchanged.

manual.detail: Nothing: st-test is read from main. Set ST_TEST_RUNS=off to record nothing.

recovery.detail: Revert this change; the runs file can be deleted.
